from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import importlib
import json
import os
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from commander.engine.engine_process import ProcessLimits, run_bounded
from commander.engine.forge_config import file_hash, jvm_library, read_settings
from commander.engine.native_runtime import _engine_profile, _environment, require_bridge
from tests.support import draw_ending_worker as rules

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BUILD = ROOT / 'data/engine-builds/8d5b4381d5a341b8a0e1c0c0b371bdbf'
TEST_CLASS = 'forge.ai.CommanderBattleBoundaryBaselineTest'
FIXTURE = WORK / 'CommanderBattleBoundaryBaselineTest.java'
NATIVE_ORIGINS = tuple(dict.fromkeys((*rules.NATIVE_CLASSES, 'forge.game.ability.effects.EncodeEffect', 'forge.game.card.CardCopyService', 'forge.game.card.Card', 'forge.ai.simulation.GameCopier', 'forge.game.combat.Combat', 'forge.game.trigger.TriggerHandler', 'forge.ai.ability.TapOrUntapAi', 'forge.game.ability.effects.TapOrUntapEffect', 'forge.ai.SpellAbilityAi', 'forge.ai.ability.TapOrUntapAllAi', 'forge.ai.ability.ChooseTypeAi', 'forge.game.ability.effects.TapOrUntapAllEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.ChooseTypeEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.ChooseColorEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.DiscardEffect', 'forge.game.cost.CostPromiseGift', 'forge.game.ability.effects.TokenEffect', 'forge.game.GameActionUtil', 'forge.game.cost.CostPayment', 'forge.game.ability.AbilityUtils', 'forge.game.ability.effects.DrawEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.CounterEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.PhasesEffect', 'forge.game.card.CounterEnumType', 'forge.game.phase.Untap', 'forge.game.zone.PlayerZoneBattlefield', 'forge.game.ability.effects.EffectEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.DestroyEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.ManaReflectedEffect', 'forge.game.card.CardProperty', 'forge.game.GameAction', 'forge.game.combat.CombatUtil', 'forge.game.ability.effects.CountersRemoveEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.FogEffect', 'forge.game.ability.effects.PlayEffect')))


def sources():
    recipe = json.loads((ROOT / 'engine/sticker_recipe.json').read_bytes())
    base = ROOT / 'engine/tests/AITest.java'
    dependency = ROOT / recipe['packaged_testng']['path']
    assert file_hash(base) == recipe['packaged_ai_base_sha256']
    assert file_hash(dependency) == recipe['packaged_testng']['sha256']
    return [base, FIXTURE], dependency


def worker(run):
    settings = read_settings(BUILD / 'engine-config.json')
    engine = settings.verify()
    metadata = json.loads((run / 'rules-inputs.json').read_bytes())
    assert all(file_hash(Path(path)) == digest for path, digest in metadata['inputs'].items())
    output = run / 'rules-classes'
    assert metadata['classes'] == {path.relative_to(output).as_posix(): file_hash(path)
                                   for path in output.rglob('*.class')}
    _, dependency = sources()
    require_bridge()
    java = importlib.import_module('jpype')
    archive = settings.home / engine['jar_name']
    java.startJVM(jvm_library(settings.java), '-Xmx1536m', '-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2',
                  '-Djava.awt.headless=true', '-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8',
                  classpath=list(map(str, (archive, output, dependency))), convertStrings=True)
    for name in NATIVE_ORIGINS:
        assert rules._origin(java, name).samefile(archive), name
    for name in ('forge.ai.AITest', TEST_CLASS):
        assert rules._origin(java, name).samefile(output), name
    runner = java.JClass('org.testng.TestNG')()
    listener = java.JClass('org.testng.TestListenerAdapter')()
    runner.addListener(listener)
    runner.setTestClasses(java.JArray(java.JClass('java.lang.Class'))([java.JClass(TEST_CLASS).class_]))
    runner.setOutputDirectory(str(run / 'reports'))
    runner.setUseDefaultListeners(True)
    runner.run()
    counts, methods = rules._results(listener)
    assert all(file_hash(Path(path)) == digest for path, digest in metadata['inputs'].items())
    record = {'scope': 'Focused research against packaged production classes; not all-card certification.',
              'engine': engine, 'counts': counts, 'methods': methods,
              'testng_status': int(runner.getStatus()),
              'configuration_failures': len(listener.getConfigurationFailures()),
              'configuration_skips': len(listener.getConfigurationSkips()),
              'inputs': metadata['inputs'], 'production_origins_verified': len(NATIVE_ORIGINS),
              'report_sha256': file_hash(run / 'reports/testng-results.xml'),
              'failures': [str(result.getThrowable()) for result in listener.getFailedTests()]}
    (run / 'evidence.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
    print(json.dumps({'counts': counts, 'failures': record['failures']}), flush=True)
    java.shutdownJVM()


def parent():
    settings = read_settings(BUILD / 'engine-config.json')
    settings.verify()
    run = WORK / 'packaged-battle-boundary10-baseline'
    run.mkdir()
    os.environ['COMMANDER_JAVAC'] = 'C:/Program Files/Java/jdk-19/bin/javac.exe'
    selected, dependency = sources()
    rules._compile(settings, run, selected, dependency)
    with _engine_profile(settings, run):
        result = run_bounded([sys.executable, '-I', str(Path(__file__).resolve()), '--worker', str(run)],
                             settings.home, run / 'native.log',
                             ProcessLimits(90, log_bytes=262144, environment=_environment(run)))
    (run / 'process.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
    assert result['status'] == 'finished' and result['returncode'] == 0, result
    record = json.loads((run / 'evidence.json').read_bytes())
    assert record['configuration_failures'] == record['configuration_skips'] == 0
    print(json.dumps({'counts': record['counts'], 'failures': record['failures'], 'process': result}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == '--worker':
        target = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(strict=True)
        assert target.parent == WORK and target.name == 'packaged-battle-boundary10-baseline'
        worker(target)
    else:
        assert len(sys.argv) == 1
        parent()
